[h2]ARENA MODE is now available![/h2]
[h3]100% Japanese Support[/h3]

As well as, bug fixes and the addition on the Auto Aim and Shooting config.

notes.title: Patch notes v1.0.4
notes.notes:
[h3]Bug fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Missing dialog on first map when you didn't have all fragments  (possibly happening on maps 2 and 3, to ne fixed)
